251374|70bfd38d.name: Windshaper Boro
251374|70bfd38d.text:
The spirits of the wind may have left us, but the power of the elements is not entirely out of reach for those with the patience to seek them out.

If you are initiated in the ways of the $c, I can help you grasp them.

252382|70bfd38d.name: Sessaria Skystride
252382|70bfd38d.text:
The spirits of the wind may have left us, but the power of the elements is not entirely out of reach for those with the patience to seek them out.

If you are initiated in the ways of the $c, I can help you grasp them.

252477|aa6ba0a9.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|aa6ba0a9.text: Is there something I can help you find?

253474|e040148b.name: Peacekeeper
253474|e040148b.text: The $c trainer can be found near the Windshaper's standing stones, on the western edge of town.

254100|10e89f38.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|10e89f38.text: If the Al'Aketh cult isn't stopped soon, we'll all be press-ganged into joining those fanatics. I will NOT look good with a shaved head.

254345|bedfc7be.name: Syriel Nightrain
254345|bedfc7be.text: Nostyec Regenthor, mod. E wirsh ador eynes re an tiras an lo vil va novaedi E gol melka ras re y bor rothas aelgestron.

257005|45c78ce3.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|45c78ce3.text: Nostyec Aetwinter, mod. E wirsh ador eynes re an tiras an lo vil va novaedi E gol melka ras re y bor rothas aelgestron.

257019|45c78ce3.name: Nyassa Swiftdraught
257019|45c78ce3.text: Nostyec Aetwinter, mod. E wirsh ador eynes re an tiras an lo vil va novaedi E gol melka ras re y bor rothas aelgestron.

268679|72aa6da2.name: Brazier of Eternal Flame
268679|72aa6da2.text: <The Braizer of Eternal Flame awaits your offering.>

272045|5a3e1b84.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|5a3e1b84.text:
Why are you looking at me like that. Do you expect me to shoot bolts of lightning at you, or threaten you with the wrath of the Windlord?

Its fair enough if you do. However, not all of us are quite so... zealous.

272045|d5d1dc84.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|d5d1dc84.text:
Tailor, by trade. 

Here stranger, I'll tell you what. Bring me any spare windstones you come across and I'll share my wares with you. I've got quite the stockpile of Al'Aketh garments here. Say what you will about the insanity of the cult, you've got to admit, they have some sense of style.

Or rather, I do, considering I designed most of their attire.

272045|fac7c2e1.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|fac7c2e1.text:
Not much story to tell. I lived in Falaath Village and when the cult moved in, I saw the winds turning. I shaved my head, donned the grey robes, and said the words they wanted to hear. 

Now I'm just trying to survive. Mostly I keep my head down and ply my trade for that crackpot, Lorthuna.

4596|b22b0c37.name: James Van Brunt
4596|b22b0c37.text: How is the edge of your steel? Good enough to cut through the belly of your enemy? Let me show you some things to make it even sharper.

442-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
442-progress.text: The Scourge cannot be allowed to remain in Silverpine, $N.  Come back to me when you have proof of Thule's death.
442-progress.title: Assault on Fenris Isle

444-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
444-progress.text: My studies require great concentration.  So I hope your visit is not a frivolous one.
444-progress.title: Rot Hide Origins

446-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
446-progress.text: Greetings, $N.  What did Bethor have to say?
446-progress.title: Thule Ravenclaw

461-progress.name: Dusty Shelf
461-progress.text: This is the spot!  Bring me closer...
461-progress.title: The Hidden Niche

496-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-progress.text: I see you are back.  I hope you were able to gather the agents I need.  Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
496-progress.title: Elixir of Suffering

501-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
501-progress.title: Elixir of Pain

529-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-progress.text: Were you able to carry out your orders, $c?  Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants?  And where is that iron shipment?
529-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

6563-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-progress.text: How goes your search for the crystals, $N? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
6563-progress.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6921-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-progress.text: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
6921-progress.title: Amongst the Ruins

6922-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-progress.text: Ah, hello again $N.  I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do.  What brings you to the outpost?
6922-progress.title: Baron Aquanis

91899-complete.name: Dokimi
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Dokimi
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91900-complete.name: Dokimi
91900-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91900-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91900-progress.name: Dokimi
91900-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91900-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92484-complete.name: Windshaper Boro
92484-complete.text:
Can you hear it? The whispers of the winds? Doubtful, considering that the spirits stopped speaking with us when they left us those years ago. 

Those among us who would seek audience with the spirits of the four winds once more hone our understanding of the elements and the natural world, dearly hoping to reestablish the dialogue that was so abruptly ended. 

Would you walk this path and master the elements?

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps and I will train you.
92484-complete.title: Embracing the Elements

92679-accept.name: Alvarion Windfield
92679-accept.text:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The $R man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679-accept.title: Blood Tithe

93159-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93159-accept.text:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... its um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?
93159-accept.title: The Strange Hermit

93159-complete.name: Strange Hermit
93159-complete.text:
...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.

I have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.
93159-complete.title: The Strange Hermit

93160-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93160-accept.text:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
93160-accept.title: The Forest's Bounty

93172-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93172-accept.text:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but its definitely a song and its... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?
93172-accept.title: Free the Hollows

93319-complete.name: Teeri Wellwind
93319-complete.text: Thanks $c. This should help us get by for now. If we can't get the supply routes squared away soon though, a few stolen windstones will be the least of our worries.
93319-complete.title: Pilfered Windstones

93949-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
93949-complete.text: I'm sure there are more of these critters around Valanaar, but every enchanted skyhopper we stomp out makes the city just a tiny bit safer.
93949-complete.title: Bugged

94242-accept.name: Unknown
94242-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Pilferer's Gloves, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94242-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Pilferer's Gloves

94484-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94484-complete.text:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>

So the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then.

It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94484-complete.title: Unnerving Silence

94485-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94485-accept.text:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.
94485-accept.title: Tears of the Lady

94486-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94486-accept.text:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
94486-accept.title: Feathers for Binding

94487-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-accept.text:
The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds in-between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487-accept.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

95664-accept.name: Unknown
95664-accept.text: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
95664-accept.title: Elder Knowledge

95697-accept.name: Borstan
95697-accept.text:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697-accept.title: Changing Tastes

95885-complete.name: Unknown
95885-complete.text:
<The offering stone is inert now. It appears your ritual drained it of power. To what end, you do not know, but it is over now.

The rough stone cracks and crumbles, now devoid of purpose.

Something glitters from within the remnants...>
95885-complete.title: The Offering of Blood

95981-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
95981-complete.text:
Ever since the barrier went down around Dalaran, the Kirin Tor have maintained a death grip on the roads. They're paranoid about something, that much is certain.

For now, however, the why is irrelevant.
95981-complete.title: Watching the Roads

96986-accept.name: Melisara
96986-accept.text:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $N, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986-accept.title: The Grave Knight

97243-accept.name: Sessaria Skystride
97243-accept.text:
Even though we are in the realm of skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.

Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.
97243-accept.title: Call of Fire

97243-complete.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97243-complete.text: So you've brought the torch. Yes, young $c, I can teach you to heed the call of fire. It will not be easy, but nothing that we do in this realm is ever easy.
97243-complete.title: Call of Fire

97243-progress.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97243-progress.text: Yes, $N? What do you have there?
97243-progress.title: Call of Fire

97244-accept.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97244-accept.text:
There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of  his former brothers and sisters.

You will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.
97244-accept.title: Call of Fire

97244-complete.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97244-complete.text:
The Windshapers do not forget, and blood is always paid with blood. It pleases me that you were able to deliver this final, painful reminder of our creed to this traitor.

This heart will not be all that feeds the flames today, however. There is one other task that needs to done.
97244-complete.title: Call of Fire

97244-progress.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97244-progress.text: The heart of a betrayer is a powerful reagent. The flames will eagerly accept such an offering and burn more intensely as it is consumed.
97244-progress.title: Call of Fire

97245-accept.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97245-accept.text:
The residents of the Shen'dar Highlands speak of an ancient forest sprite called Kuramaa. They say it lives inside of a twisted stump at the summit of a hill near the highlands Anchor Pylon.

Go to the highlands and find this stump. Rap your fist upon the bark and Kuramaa will appear. Best the spirit in combat, and bring me its wooden mask.

Be warned however, this entity will be exceptionally resistant to much of your magic. Only the touch of flame will lay low the spirit.
97245-accept.title: Call of Fire

97245-complete.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97245-complete.text: We now have what we need. We will light the eternal flame and commune with the spirits of fire.
97245-complete.title: Call of Fire

97245-progress.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97245-progress.text: The spirit of Kuramaa is eternal, and it will manifest again when it is needed. It's mask is a source of great power, and will prove invaluable to the ritual we must complete.
97245-progress.title: Call of Fire

97257-accept.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97257-accept.text:
Now we will perform the ritual. 

I will place the materials onto the altar and call forth the spirits of flame. If the offering is accepted, they will appear and light the Eternal Flame. You will then hold your torch forth and capture the flame.

Carry the lit torch to Valanaar and place it in the Brazier of Eternal Flames. You must do so quickly, for the flames of the Firelands are quick to dissipate here in Skywall.
97257-accept.title: Call of Fire

97257-complete.name: Sessaria Skystride
97257-complete.text:
It is done. The Eternal Flame burns once again.

Your trial is now complete. I am pleased to present you with your Fire Totem. Use this icon of power well in your travels, $N. 

Just remember, the power of the elemental plane serves those that respect it, and consumes those who do not. This is our way.
97257-complete.title: Call of Fire

97257-progress.name: Sessaria Skystride
97257-progress.text: You have done well to come this far. You do the Windshapers honor, $N.
97257-progress.title: Call of Fire

97968-complete.name: Syriel Nightrain
97968-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97968-complete.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

98094-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
98094-accept.text:
Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.

Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.
98094-accept.title: Scout Support

98248-complete.name: Dokimi
98248-complete.text:
You found the right place, and you're speaking with the right person! I can jot you down as one of our new associates. No paperwork necessary on your part, I can't be bothered with more of that.

All we ask of you is to assist in dealing with compromised deliveries you find during your travels. Doing so will earn you Merchant's Favor, which you can use to purchase goods and services right here. Here's a bit to get you settled in!

Do you happen to have the crate this label came with?
98248-complete.title: Shipping Label

98248-progress.name: Dokimi
98248-progress.text: Good day, traveler. How can I assist?
98248-progress.title: Shipping Label
